sources.authority: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.title: Anaemia Mukt Bharat — current programme page
verified_claims: Preconception and first-trimester folic acid programme advice is 400 mcg daily.
Pregnant women and lactating mothers are listed for daily IFA from the fourth month/second trimester, minimum 180 days in pregnancy and 180 days postpartum.
The listed pregnancy/lactation IFA tablet contains 60 mg elemental iron and 500 mcg folic acid.
Testing and treatment of anaemia are delegated to the AMB operational guidelines rather than fully specified on the programme page.
sources.limitations: This programme page is sufficient for current prophylactic programme facts but not for detailed treatment thresholds or IV-iron protocols.

sources.authority: Indian Council of Medical Research / Department of Health Research, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.title: Standard Treatment Workflow for Ante-Natal Management of Normal Pregnancy
verified_claims: First visit includes haemoglobin testing and daily folic acid.
Second trimester workflow lists IFA once daily if Hb >11 g% and twice daily if Hb <11 g%.
It lists calcium carbonate 500 mg with vitamin D 250 units twice daily with meals.
It states calcium carbonate and IFA should not be given together.
It states referral if there is no rise in Hb after four weeks of oral tablets.
Later-visit text includes parenteral iron/referral language for lower Hb values; these are clinician-facing treatment actions and are not eligible for autonomous Janani treatment advice.
sources.limitations: The STW is advisory and clinician-facing. Treatment statements must not be translated into autonomous consumer prescribing.

sources.authority: Maternal Health Division, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.title: National Guidelines for Calcium Supplementation During Pregnancy and Lactation
sources.version_or_date: December 2014; still listed on the current NHM Maternal Health guideline index in 2026
verified_claims: The guideline targets all pregnant women and recommends calcium-rich-food counselling.
It specifies 1 g elemental calcium per day as two 500 mg doses from 14 weeks of pregnancy through six months postpartum.
Each tablet is specified as 500 mg elemental calcium with 250 IU vitamin D3, taken with meals twice daily.
It advises against taking both calcium doses together and against taking calcium and IFA together.
sources.limitations: The document is from 2014. It remains on the current NHM guideline index, but postpartum duration, exact timing and formulation still require clinician/current-programme reconciliation before Janani uses them as consumer rules.
